name: Side glazing panel
reference: Rail laminated safety glazing, AGC Lamisafe/Heatlight W class
geometry_basis: AGC rail glazing page: laminated Lamisafe front glass and Heatlight W heated anti-fog glass family; OSR aperture sets the panel size.
cost_basis: Derived from BOM B10: 18 cassettes / 6,000 USD base after Alibaba laminated transport-glass listed-price pass; rail quotes vary with heating, curvature, and certification pack.

name: Rooftop HVAC unit
reference: Compact/split roof rail HVAC, Liebherr passenger-saloon class
geometry_basis: Liebherr rail HVAC page: passenger saloon units integrate power supply, pressure protection, air ducts, diagnostics, and controls; available as compact/split, roof/floor mounted units.
cost_basis: Derived from BOM T14: 3 HVAC units / 12,000 USD base after Alibaba electric bus roof-HVAC listed-price pass; high end covers hot-climate rail-qualified package and pressure-protection options.

name: Continuous LED ceiling strip
reference: Teknoware rolling-stock main/emergency LED lighting rail
geometry_basis: Teknoware rail lighting catalogue family: interior lighting, main/emergency functions, serviceable rail-and-road vehicle modules.
cost_basis: Derived from BOM B16: 6 ceiling strip runs / 1,500 USD base after Alibaba/AliExpress 24 V bus-light listed-price pass; includes emergency-mode rail wiring allowance.

name: Passenger-information LCD
geometry_basis: Luminator LUM LED Rail S datasheet: 1125 × 210 × 45 mm housing, 5.4 kg max, 24 V DC, 31 W typical / 65 W max.
cost_basis: Derived from BOM E14: 12 onboard displays / 3,000 USD base after Alibaba bus/metro display listed-price pass; high end covers rail LCD/LED display controller and EMC evidence.

name: Longitudinal bench run
reference: Compin-Fainsa SB09 Metro/LRV longitudinal seat class
geometry_basis: Compin-Fainsa SB09 page: longitudinal/transversal metro/LRV installation, removable pads, light alloy frame, EN45545 HL2/HL3 evidence.
cost_basis: Derived from BOM B14: 60 seats / 6,000 USD after Alibaba bus/metro seat listed-price pass, represented as 18 multi-seat bench runs per consist.

name: Vertical grab pole
reference: Rail interior stainless stanchion kit, Compin-Fainsa/Teknoware interior class
geometry_basis: Rail interior stanchion class: stainless vertical pole with floor/ceiling flanges and modular grab-rail interfaces.
cost_basis: Derived from BOM B15: 24 primary stanchions / 2,500 USD base after Alibaba bus handrail fittings listed-price pass.

name: Emergency intercom / help-point
reference: Televic TRACS passenger communication unit / IP audio class
geometry_basis: Televic TRACS passenger communication class: recessed wall help-point, audio fallback, Ethernet/SIP train communication module.
cost_basis: BOM B19 includes CCTV + intercom kit; this row assigns a 250 USD planning unit after Alibaba bus CCTV/intercom listed-price pass.
